text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Privatisation of Livestock Transport and Trading Co is being studied.
- Parliament to hold extraordinary sessions on Saturdays to discuss government agenda.
- Parliament to discuss unemployment in Tuesday's session.
- Kuwait Finance Centre to be listed on Kuwait Stock Exchange soon.
- Kuwait Municipality needs change, performance at low level, Municipal Council member Khalifa al-Kharafi says.
- Parliament's legal panel approves proposed amendments to press law.
